basis.summary: Both claims come from a single paper and are reported background about other species (Wuchang bream, loach), not crucian carp, so I stated the supportive direction while flagging the species mismatch and limited evidence; there was no disagreement to resolve.

statement_en: Two claims, both from one paper and both reported as background, describe dietary tea polyphenols as helping fish under ammonia stress: they reduced ammonia-induced oxidative damage in juvenile Wuchang bream by strengthening antioxidant defence and immune function, and they changed the gut microbiota of loach and enriched amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis pathways under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress. Neither claim is about crucian carp, and no doses or disagreeing results are given.
statement_zh: 两条结论都来自同一篇论文,且都是作为背景引用的:日粮添加茶多酚可减轻氨暴露引起的武昌鱼幼鱼氧化损伤,主要是增强抗氧化防御和免疫功能;在慢性氨氮胁迫下,茶多酚还改变了泥鳅的肠道菌群组成,并富集了氨基酸和核苷酸合成相关的代谢通路。两条都不是鲫鱼的结果,也没有给出剂量,没有相互矛盾的结果。

One says the injection reproduced acute bacterial disease, but neither reports a measured welfare outcome beyond that.
